ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager holds a big curly shell to one ear, far from the beach, and hears the sea.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has found a big curly shell up near the gardens, far from the beach. (subject.He/She) holds it to (subject.his/her) ear, the way children do, and hears the sea: a soft, rushing, faraway roar. But the sea is a long way off from here. (subject) takes the shell away from (subject.his/her) ear and listens. Nothing. Shell back. The sea.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) listens and hears it too. They try it with a small shell: a smaller, higher sea. They try it with a cupped hand: a sort of sea. They try it with a coconut shell: a very confused sea. "Maybe it's not the sea at all," says (friend). "Maybe it's just what quiet sounds like, up close." (subject) holds the big shell to (subject.his/her) ear again. It still sounds like the sea.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) decides not to work it out. (subject.He/She) takes the shell home and keeps it by (subject.his/her) sleeping mat. On nights when (subject.he/she) can't sleep, (subject.he/she) holds it to (subject.his/her) ear and listens to the sea that isn't there, and falls asleep before (subject.he/she) can wonder about it too much.
